definitions: A female given name, a variant of Mary.
An ancient city-state located in modern-day Syria, on the Euphrates River.
A Finno-Ugric ethnic group native to the Mari El Republic and other regions of Russia.
The language spoken by the Mari people.
examples: Mari is a popular name in many cultures.
Archaeologists have uncovered significant artifacts from the ancient city of Mari.
The Mari people have a rich cultural heritage.
She is studying the Mari language.
